policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists must obtain Turkmenistan's visa at the competent mission before travel.
conditions: Applies to stays up to 90 days; excludes transit, work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Guinea-Bissau advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists must obtain Guinea-Bissau's visa through the competent embassy before travel.
conditions: This excludes work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists must obtain Sudan's visa through the competent embassy before travel.
conditions: The current guidance identifies a one-month visa and embassy application; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: South Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists must obtain South Sudan's visa through the competent embassy before travel.
conditions: This excludes conditional third-country travel documentation, non-visitor purposes, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Djibouti advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists must obtain Djibouti's visa through the competent embassy before travel.
conditions: The Danish MFA does not identify a Danish eVisa or arrival-visa route; this excludes non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists can obtain Jordan's visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Certain land crossings may not issue visas and should be confirmed with Jordan's embassy; that route exception does not displace the arrival route.
This excludes special documents, non-visitor purposes and final admission.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Sierra Leone electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Danish ordinary-passport tourists can obtain Sierra Leone's eVisa before travel.
conditions: Applies to stays up to 30 days and excludes special documents, non-visitor purposes and final admission.
